deliveryAreas.page.title: Delivery Areas
deliveryAreas.page.description: Manage delivery coverage, fees, availability, and approval status.
deliveryAreas.searchPlaceholder: Search by Arabic or English name...
deliveryAreas.dialog.createDescription: Create a delivery area and configure its fee, availability, and initial status.
deliveryAreas.dialog.editDescription: Update the delivery area's names, fee, and availability. Status is managed separately.
deliveryAreas.form.statusHint: Only active, confirmed, non-deleted areas are available to customers.
deliveryAreas.form.deliveryFeeHint: Enter zero or a positive delivery fee.
deliveryAreas.form.freeDeliveryFeeHint: The backend stores and returns a zero fee for free-delivery areas.
deliveryAreas.form.freeDeliveryHint: Enable this to normalise the delivery fee to zero.
deliveryAreas.form.activeHint: Inactive areas are not available to customers even when confirmed.
deliveryAreas.validation.deliveryFeeRequ: A valid delivery fee is required.
deliveryAreas.statusDialog.title: Change Delivery Area Status
deliveryAreas.statusDialog.hint: Confirmed areas can be shown to customers when active. Restricted and pending areas remain unavailable publicly.
deliveryAreas.details.title: Delivery Area Details
deliveryAreas.details.description: View delivery configuration, usage, and audit information.
deliveryAreas.deleteDialog.title: Delete Delivery Area
deliveryAreas.deleteDialog.description: This soft-deletes the delivery area and removes it from normal admin and customer results.
deliveryAreas.deleteDialog.blocked_one: This area cannot be deleted because {{count}} active customer address uses it. Restrict or deactivate the area instead.
deliveryAreas.deleteDialog.blocked_other: This area cannot be deleted because {{count}} active customer addresses use it. Restrict or deactivate the area instead.
deliveryAreas.restoreDialog.title: Restore Delivery Area
deliveryAreas.restoreDialog.description: Restore this delivery area. Restoration will fail if another active area now uses the same Arabic or English name.
deliveryAreas.errors.duplicateName: Another active delivery area already uses the same Arabic or English name.
deliveryAreas.errors.hasActiveAddresses: This delivery area cannot be deleted while active customer addresses use it. Restrict or deactivate it instead.
deliveryAreas.errors.notFound: The delivery area was not found or is no longer available for this operation.
deliveryAreas.errors.invalidRequest: The delivery area request is invalid.
deliveryAreas.errors.unknown: The delivery area request could not be completed.
